components.name: ContentRow
components.description: A settings row holding content below its label, such as a text area or a list: a VStack row of a grouped form on macOS, a SettingsCard with ContentAlignment Vertical on Windows 11 (the content 8 below the header, stretched), or a boxed-list row built of AdwActionRow's header on GNOME. It joins a Card, a Fieldset, an AccordionItem or a PreferencesGroup as ActionRow does.

components.name: PreferencesGroup
components.description: A group of settings rows under a header with controls at the end of its line and a description: a grouped form's Section with a header and a footer on macOS, a settings section with its header and cards on Windows 11, or AdwPreferencesGroup with its header suffix and description on GNOME. Its rows join as a Fieldset's do.

components.name: PrefixRow
components.description: An ActionRow with content before its title, such as an icon, an avatar or a tile: a grouped form's row with an image on macOS (10 in, the title 10 after it), a SettingsCard's HeaderIcon on Windows 11, or AdwActionRow's prefixes on GNOME. It joins a group as ActionRow does, its separators unbroken.

components.name: RadioRow
components.description: A settings row choosing a value, one of the radio rows sharing it, a click anywhere on the row choosing it and Up and Down moving among those of its group: a radio-group Picker's row on macOS, the radio button at its trailing edge; a clickable SettingsCard with a RadioButton as its HeaderIcon on Windows 11; or AdwActionRow with a grouped check button as its prefix on GNOME. Assistive technology sees one radio button named by its title.
